issues.description: Re-import always passes take="openspec" instead of a three-way merge: a unit edited on both sides is silently resolved to OpenSpec and the bank edit is lost. No check that an existing topic's openspec_source matches the imported change_dir, so a topic can be silently re-linked.
issues.recommendation: For an existing topic verify openspec_source first (reject unlinked/other-change topics); for the same source call plan_sync without take and abort without writes on conflict.

issues.description: With missing/corrupt sidecar and changed source, synthetic_sidecar marks only text hashes unknown but accepts current OpenSpec checkbox states as baseline. Old false, OpenSpec true, bank false: no conflict, and the next export overwrites the OpenSpec tick back to false.
issues.recommendation: Treat checkbox as an unknown unit when no reliable sidecar; emit a conflict if the sides differ before writing a baseline; add a regression test.

issues.description: Batch sync is not all-or-nothing: _sync_topic writes each successful topic immediately; a later conflicting topic leaves earlier ones modified, contrary to AGR-105 (any conflict -> no writes).
issues.recommendation: Two phases: plan all topics without writes, apply only if no conflicts/errors; test first-ok/second-conflict leaves both untouched.

issues.description: No compare-and-swap between hash check/bank read and the later writes: concurrent OpenSpec edit after the hash check is overwritten; concurrent bank requirements.md edit is lost because rebaseline (lines 269-272) writes the stale bank[0].
issues.recommendation: Re-verify all OpenSpec bytes vs job.old and the bank triple vs snapshot immediately before the first write; abort on drift; make the requirements.md rewrite conditional on unchanged bytes.

issues.description: export --new creates OpenSpec files then mutates the bank via several independent atomic_writes. A crash mid-way leaves a partial change; re-run refuses because change_dir exists; a crash after tasks/sidecar but before requirements frontmatter leaves a half-modified, unlinked bank topic.
issues.recommendation: Build the change in a sibling temp dir and rename atomically; make bank linking resumable (complete missing bank writes when an identical change already exists).

issues.description: Write guard does not implement 'no path component is archive': it only checks real.name and immediate parents. /backup/archive/project/openspec/changes/id passes. Test covers only openspec/changes/archive/<id>.
issues.recommendation: Reject if "archive" in real.parts; add a test with archive in an earlier component incl. symlinked parent.

issues.description: export --new can write an internal REQ-ID into OpenSpec: a requirement outside a recognised ### Requirement heading is named by its rid ('### Requirement: REQ-007'), violating AGR-105.
issues.recommendation: Generate a neutral stable name (e.g. 'Requirement 1'); add a test with an ungrouped requirement asserting no 'REQ-' in any created OpenSpec file.

issues.description: _print_sync_results prints action="error" as a warning but leaves rc=0, so missing source/corrupt frontmatter exits 0 and automation proceeds with a stale bank.
issues.recommendation: Set rc=1 on action="error" like conflict; add CLI test for non-zero exit and no writes on missing source.

issues.description: 'reads back to the same units' compares only REQ bullet and checkbox lines; design.md, scenario placement/Covers, anchors/meta and the full triple are not checked, so the Stage 9 DoD 'importer reads back the same triple' is under-tested.
issues.recommendation: Compare all three re-imported files to the expected canonical triple (excluding only documented projection-only fields); test shared scenario and Why/What Changes.

issues.description: ~280 lines mixing path/security guards, triple IO, discovery and backlog mutation; nearest SRP risk.
issues.recommendation: After security fixes, split into path guards and topic persistence/discovery.
